messages:
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT created: zenith-corp websocket errors -> elevated timeouts and retry storms against VPC Gateway (dedicated-pool-5). Paging oncall.
Ava: paging @oncall — I'm seeing >= 40% 502/stream-timeouts from zenith tenant in the last 3m. Dedicated pool CPU spikes and tail latency. :rotating_light:
Diego: noted, looking at gpu metrics. Is this only websocket (streaming) or also REST? Marta (Zenith): only streaming, REST works fine.
Priya: can we confirm per-tenant isolation? If retry storms from their gateway are saturating the pool we should throttle at gateway ingress for that tenant.
Sam: quick check: traffic pattern shows rapid reconnects from a single source IP range (zenith-corp). Retries are exponential but no jitter; second-level bursts.
Ava: launching canary mitigation plan: 1) put zenith on a soft rate-limit (200 rps) at ingress 2) enable per-tenant queueing with max_inflight=8 3) route to fallback-runtime (lower perf) if latency > 1.2s. Rolling now.
Diego: applied soft rate-limit at edge (nginx):
```
server {
  location /vpc/stream/ {
    limit_req zone=zenith burst=50 nodelay;
  }
}
```
Priya: I enabled tenant queueing on dedicated-pool-5: zenith queue cap 8, overflow -> reject with 429. Watching.
Marta (Zenith): thanks — we're seeing retries climb on our side. We'll patch client to add jitter and backoff but that will take ~45m. Any temporary suggestions?
Sam: ask them to add a 500-1500ms jitter and cap reconnect attempts to 3. Also increase websocket ping interval to 30s to avoid idle disconnects causing reconnections.
Ava: fallback routing applied: zenith traffic now split 80/20 to fallback-runtime (cold) via routing rule `tenant_route(zenith)->fallback-rt`.
Alertbot: Alert: dedicated-pool-5 CPU decreased by 32% after rate-limit and split.
Priya: seeing 502s drop from 42% -> 7% in last 2m. Latency tail still slightly elevated for a small subset. Holding mitigation.
Marta (Zenith): rolling client patch now. We also enabled client-side per-connection leaky-bucket. Will update when deployed.
Diego: logs show some long-running KV-cache warmups from streaming sessions causing memory pressure. I'll evict stale cache entries for zenith sessions (ttl 600s) as extra mitigation.
Ava: eviction triggered.
Sam: can we loosen HTTP keepalive on the pool to 45s to reduce connection churn? Might help.
Priya: changed keepalive from 15s -> 45s for zenith routing rule.
Ava: oncall handoff: @Diego will take primary for mitigation through next hour, @Priya backup. I'm going to brief infra and then update the zenith ops channel.
Diego: ack, taking over. Will continue to monitor and coordinate with Marta.
Marta (Zenith): patch deployed, retry storm subsided, client is back to 5% recon rate. We're running internal ramp tests now.
Priya: metrics: error rate steady at 2-3%, latency p95 improved. I recommend we keep soft rate-limit and queueing for 2 hours while we confirm stability, then gradually relax.
Ava: agreed. Next actions logged:
- Keep rate-limit & queueing for 2h (Ava)
- Follow up with Zenith on permanent retry jitter + recon cap (Marta)
- Postmortem: capture cause (client retry behavior) + recommended defensive rules (Priya)
- Consider per-tenant token bucket enforcement (Sam)
Diego: if things hold, I'll remove fallback routing after 1h and scale dedicated-pool-5 down then up to clear cold state.
Ava: handing off pager to @Diego. If errors reappear, escalate to oncall-2 and notify SRE leads.
Oncall Bot: Handoff recorded. New owner: Diego. Pager reassigned.
Sam: quick note for postmortem: include guidance for customers integrating via websocket: retry-with-jitter, capped reconnects, respect 429 and backoff, and keepalive tuning.
Marta (Zenith): appreciate the rapid mitigation and clear guidance. We'll schedule a joint follow-up postmortem and action items from our engineering team.
Ava: thanks everyone. Closing active mitigation—moving to monitoring mode. Will update when we fully relax limits. :white_check_mark:
